Name: Information
Description: Displays additional information or metadata about the aperture operation and its current settings.

Name: Mode
Description: Specifies the morphological operation to apply to the input, affecting how features are expanded or contracted.

Flubs.Name: Dilation
Flubs.Description: Expands or grows features in the input by the specified shape and size, filling small holes and connecting nearby elements.

Flubs.Name: Erosion
Flubs.Description: Contracts or shrinks features in the input by the specified shape and size, removing small details and separating connected elements.

Name: Size
Description: Sets the size of the structuring element (aperture) used for the operation. Larger values increase the effect's reach.

Name: Shape
Description: Determines the geometric shape of the structuring element used for dilation or erosion, affecting the style of the transformation.

Flubs.Name: Disk
Flubs.Description: Uses a circular (disk-shaped) structuring element for smooth, rounded transformations.

Flubs.Name: Polygon
Flubs.Description: Uses a regular polygon as the structuring element, allowing for custom-sided shapes.

Flubs.Name: Asterisk
Flubs.Description: Uses a star or asterisk-shaped structuring element, emphasizing cross-like or radiating effects.

Flubs.Name: Line
Flubs.Description: Uses a straight line as the structuring element, applying the effect directionally.

Flubs.Name: Corner
Flubs.Description: Uses a corner-shaped structuring element, targeting angular or edge features.

Name: Vertices Count
Description: For polygon shapes, sets the number of vertices (sides) used, controlling the regularity and appearance of the structuring element.

Name: Corner Angle
Description: Specifies the angle of the corner for the 'Corner' shape, adjusting the sharpness or openness of the structuring element.

Name: Direction
Description: Sets the orientation or direction for directional shapes (such as Line or Asterisk), controlling the angle of the effect.

Name: Antialiased
Description: If enabled, applies antialiasing to the aperture operation, smoothing the edges of the transformed features for a cleaner result.
